---
name: Improvement
about: Propose a quality, productivity or observability improvement.
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem and desired outcome

Explain the current cost or failure, who encounters it, and the smallest useful
outcome. Link existing related work before proposing another authority/tool.

## Acceptance and scope

State observable acceptance criteria, dependencies and what is outside scope.

## Evidence or hypothesis

Link evidence for the problem. For claimed effectiveness or cost improvements,
name the baseline, comparison conditions and measurements; label unknowns.
